audit.whatIsWrong: Spikes and prose repeatedly claim Azir has 'no dash until level 9' and that his level 6 offers 'no answer to a Distortion gap-close'.
audit.why: Shifting Sands is a basic ability available from level 3-4, cooldown 22/20.5/19/17.5/16, and it carries a shield. Emperor's Divide (120/105/90) creates terrain and knocks back, which is a direct answer to a W dash-in.
audit.corrected: Spike timings rewritten around Shifting Sands being spent (22s at rank 1) and Emperor's Divide being a 120s knockback wall.

audit.whatIsWrong: Text credited a shield to 'Shurima's Legacy' (the passive, which summons the Disc of the Sun from turret ruins) and called LeBlanc's dash her E.
audit.why: Azir's shield is on Shifting Sands (E). LeBlanc's dash is Distortion (W, 15/13.75/12.5/11.25/10); her E is Ethereal Chains, a 925-range projectile that roots after 1.5s. Emperor's Divide is terrain and knocks back, so it cuts a W dash path and displaces her mid-string.
audit.corrected: Shield attributed to Shifting Sands; dash referred to as W; Emperor's Divide named as the terrain/knockback answer.

audit.why: The field exists to hold real numbers; Shifting Sands 22s->16s and Emperor's Divide 120s->90s are the two clocks this lane runs on.

audit.why: Distortion deals damage on arrival and can be re-activated within 4s to return. The finishing tool is the Sigil of Malice detonation.

edits.after: - Shifting Sands: 22s at rank 1, 16s at rank 5 — his shielded dash out. Step in once it is spent. - Emperor's Divide is 120s at rank 1: it knocks you back and walls your W path. - Your own W is 15s at rank 1 — poking it away is a death you scheduled.

edits.before: Azir is one of the most miserable early laners in the game — no dash until level 9 (second point in E), a passive-reliant wave clear, and a kit that folls apart if he's caught out. Your E-Q poke chunks him for free every time he steps up to farm, and W's soul-fragment slow lets you finish anything he tries to walk away from. Look to all-in around level 3 the moment he oversteps his soldier's range; without Shifting Sands he has zero engage or escape.
edits.after: Azir is one of the most fragile early laners in the game — Conquering Sands is 14s at rank 1, his clear leans on soldiers he must keep re-summoning, and he folds the moment he is caught out of position. Your E-Q poke chunks him every time he steps up to farm, and the sigil detonation finishes anything he tries to walk away from. All-in at 3 the moment he oversteps his soldier's 525 range; with Shifting Sands spent he has no engage and no escape for 22 seconds.

edits.before: This is where you close it out. Level 6 R-E-Q-W is a full burst combo that kills him through his shield if he's pushed even a little, and his Arise! soldiers can't zone your E dash the way they can a melee diver. Keep shoving him into turret with your superior clear speed, then roam — Azir has no wave-clear answer to a pushed lane and no mobility to punish your roams before 9. Ward his flanks since his only real threat pre-6 is a jungle gank.
edits.after: This is where you close it out. Level 6 E-Q-W into the mimic burns through the Shifting Sands shield if he's pushed even a little, and Arise! soldiers cannot body-block your W the way they wall off a melee diver. Keep shoving him into turret with your superior clear speed, then roam — Azir clears slowly without stacked soldiers and his 120s Emperor's Divide is his only answer to a collapse. Ward his flanks since his only real threat pre-6 is a jungle gank.

edits.before: Once Azir hits his mid-game item spike (Shurima's Legacy CDR, then a Rabadon's/Liandry's core) and gets full soldier walls up, his poke and zone control start to catch up to your burst — his ultimate literally splits the map and can wall off your dash-in. You want to end the game before he's a 3-item soldier fortress; if it drags to late you need picks pre-teamfight rather than diving his backline through a soldier wall.
